feed.title: Google Cloud: App Engine standard environment PHP
feed.subtitle: Changelog for Google Cloud product: App Engine standard environment PHP

entry.content:
The following runtime language contains important security updates:

  • PHP 8.2 and later: 8.2.35, 8.3.36, 8.4.27, 8.5.12

The following stacks and their underlying operating system packages have also been updated:

  • google-22, google-22-full
  • google-24, google-24-full

Take immediate protective action by rebuilding and redeploying your resources with updated dependencies.

See Security bulletins for Google Cloud for more information.
entry.summary: Important security updates are now available for PHP 8.2 and later, as well as for google-22 and google-24 stacks. Rebuild and redeploy your resources with the updated dependencies to ensure protection.
entry.title: Security: Runtime Security Updates Available

entry.content:
All supported versions of PHP 8.2 and later are patched. Take immediate protective action by redeploying your resources with updated dependencies.

See Responding to core PHP vulnerabilities for more information.
entry.summary: All supported versions of PHP 8.2 and later have been patched. To ensure security, redeploy your resources with updated dependencies immediately. This action is crucial to protect against recent vulnerabilities.
entry.title: Security: PHP Security Update Recommended

entry.content:
This note is incorrect; follow guidance in the entry for October 22, 2026.

Patch updates to supported PHP runtimes are available with deployments from source: 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, and 8.2.35. PHP workloads have automatically been patched. See Responding to core PHP vulnerabilities for more information.
entry.summary: Critical security patches have been applied to supported PHP runtimes to address recent vulnerabilities. Users are advised to review the details of these updates and ensure their applications are running on the latest patched versions.
entry.title: Security: PHP Runtime Security Update

entry.content: App Engine permanently blocks insecure traffic with TLS version 1.1 and earlier. For appspot.com domains, this block occurs at the connection level. For custom domains, the connection might succeed, but the requests are blocked. For more information, see Secure minimum TLS.
entry.summary: App Engine now permanently blocks insecure traffic using TLS version 1.1 and earlier. This change ensures enhanced security for all applications hosted on App Engine. For details on how this affects your custom domains, please refer to the secure minimum TLS documentation.
entry.title: Feature: App Engine ends support for older TLS versions

entry.content: To improve security, starting in August 2026, App Engine opts your application into TLS version 1.2 and later. You can opt out until the end of August 2026. Starting in September 2026, App Engine might permanently block insecure traffic with TLS version 1.1 and earlier. For more information, see Secure minimum TLS.
entry.summary: App Engine is enforcing TLS 1.2 and later for improved security starting August 2026. You can opt out until the end of August 2026, after which older TLS versions may be blocked.
entry.title: Feature: App Engine TLS Update

entry.content: Support for enabling only needed legacy bundled services using the app_engine_bundled_services field is in General Availability.
entry.summary: You can now selectively enable legacy bundled services for your App Engine applications. Use the app_engine_bundled_services field in your app.yaml file to specify only the services you need. This feature is now in General Availability.
entry.title: Feature: Control bundled services

entry.content: App Engine supports Direct VPC egress in Preview. Direct VPC egress lets your workloads access VPC network resources as a simpler, more cost-effective alternative to Serverless VPC Access connectors.
entry.summary: App Engine now supports Direct VPC egress in preview. This feature allows your workloads to access VPC network resources, providing a simpler and more cost-effective alternative to Serverless VPC Access connectors.
entry.title: Feature: Direct VPC egress for App Engine now in preview

entry.content: Enable only needed legacy bundled services using the app_engine_bundled_services field for improved security and maintainability of your applications (Preview).
entry.summary: You can now enable only the legacy bundled services your application needs using the app_engine_bundled_services field. This improves security and maintainability. This feature is in Preview.
entry.title: Feature: Control legacy bundled services

entry.content: The App Engine Migration hub lets you migrate services in the App Engine standard environment to Cloud Run, and also provides cost-saving recommendations. For more information, see Deploy an App Engine app in the standard environment to Cloud Run (Preview).
entry.summary: You can now migrate App Engine standard environment services to Cloud Run with the App Engine Migration hub. This tool also offers recommendations to help you save costs.
entry.title: Feature: App Engine migration to Cloud Run

entry.content: Support for the PHP 8.5 runtime is in General Availability.
entry.summary: The PHP 8.5 runtime for App Engine standard environment is now in General Availability. This update brings the latest PHP features and performance improvements to your applications. You can now deploy and run your PHP applications with confidence on this stable and supported runtime.
entry.title: Feature: PHP 8.5 runtime now available

entry.content: Support for deploying your existing apps in the standard environment to Cloud Run using the gcloud beta app migrate-to-run command is in Preview. For more information, see Deploy an App Engine app in the standard environment to Cloud Run.
entry.summary: You can now migrate your existing App Engine standard environment applications to Cloud Run using the `gcloud beta app migrate-to-run` command. This feature is currently in preview and allows for a smoother transition to a more flexible serverless platform. For detailed instructions, refer to the official documentation.
entry.title: Feature: Migrate App Engine standard to Cloud Run

entry.summary: The PHP 8.5 runtime is now available in preview. This update brings new features and improvements to the PHP environment on App Engine Standard.
entry.title: Feature: PHP 8.5 runtime now in preview

entry.content: PHP 5 is deprecated. You won't be able to deploy PHP 5 applications, even if your organization previously used an organization policy to re-enable deployments of legacy runtimes. Your existing PHP 5 applications will continue to run and receive traffic. We recommend that you migrate to the latest supported version of PHP.
entry.summary: PHP 5 is no longer supported. New deployments are disabled, but existing applications will continue to run. We recommend migrating to a supported PHP version.
entry.title: Deprecated: PHP 5 Deprecation

entry.content: To increase security, starting in March 2025, support for Transport Layer Security (TLS) version 1.1 and earlier is deprecated. Update your application settings in the App Engine standard environment to use TLS version 1.2 and later, along with a corresponding secure set of cipher suites (Preview).
entry.title: Feature: TLS 1.1 and earlier deprecated in March 2025.

entry.content: Support for the PHP 8.4 runtime is in General Availability (GA).
entry.summary: PHP 8.4 runtime is now generally available. This update provides new features and improvements for your applications.
entry.title: Feature: PHP 8.4 runtime now available
